description: This file defines the InsideViewLogicHook class, which integrates InsideView data into SuiteCRM by generating URLs for account, opportunity, lead, and contact frames, and rendering a Smarty template with embedded InsideView content in the DetailView context.

classes.name: InsideViewLogicHook
classes.description: A class providing methods to generate InsideView URLs for different CRM entities and rendering the InsideView iframe in the DetailView.

methods.name: handleFieldMap
methods.description: Constructs URL query parameters from a bean and a field mapping, handling nested arrays for multiple source fields.

methods.name: getAccountFrameUrl
methods.description: Builds the InsideView URL for an Account entity using its fields.

methods.name: getOpportunityFrameUrl
methods.description: Builds the InsideView URL for an Opportunity entity.

methods.name: getLeadFrameUrl
methods.description: Builds the InsideView URL for a Lead entity.

methods.name: getContactFrameUrl
methods.description: Builds the InsideView URL for a Contact entity.

methods.name: showFrame
methods.description: Main method to display the InsideView iframe in the DetailView, constructing the URL based on the bean type and rendering the Smarty template.
